svg.aria-label: How Grove compares with gbrain and Supermemory
svg.title: How Grove compares with gbrain and Supermemory
svg.desc: Grove keeps one map of your world with you at the centre; gbrain keeps folders and notes; Supermemory keeps a graph of documents and memories. All three share memory across your AI tools and keep history. Grove also knows when each fact was last confirmed, with a date to re-check, tells said from done, and grows its vocabulary with your world.
